arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
from datetime import datetime, time

# Test various timezone formats
test_cases = [
    ('+0100', '+01:00'),
    ('+01:00', '+01:00'),
    ('-0500', '-05:00'),
    ('-05:00', '-05:00'),
    ('+0000', '+00:00'),
    ('Z', 'UTC'),  # Special case
]

for input_tz, expected_name in test_cases:
    fmt = f'a {{:ti}} b'
    if input_tz == 'Z':
        s = f'a 1997-07-16T19:20{input_tz} b'
    else:
        s = f'a 1997-07-16T19:20{input_tz} b'
    
    result = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    tz_info = result.fixed[0].tzinfo
    
    print(f'{input_tz:>6} -> name={tz_info._name!r:>8}, offset={tz_info._offset}')
    assert tz_info._name == expected_name, f'Expected name {expected_name!r}, got {tz_info._name!r}'
    
print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
